prompt:
The history of tea

A Tea has been consumed for thousands of years, first as a medicinal drink in ancient China before it became a daily habit.

B By the seventeenth century, tea had reached Europe, where it was traded as a luxury good among the wealthy.

C Today tea is the second most widely consumed drink in the world after water, grown commercially in more than thirty countries.
